title: Have, There Is, Need and Want
objective: Say what you have, need and want at breakfast, and ask what the café has.
focus: tener, hay, necesitar, querer and hay que + infinitive

words.note: The accent separates té (tea) from te (you).

words.en: Do you have fresh orange juice?
words.note: Natural means freshly squeezed, not from a carton.

words.en: I'd like a tea without sugar.
words.note: Quisiera is a softer, more polite way to say quiero.

words.en: Do you have to pay at the register?

words.note: Spanish says 'I have hunger': tengo hambre.

speaking: Tell a server you are hungry, ask if they have fresh orange juice, and say you need a fork and a napkin.
